<thought>To obtain all possible precursor sets for the given target molecule using template 1914384, I will apply the retrosynthetic template to the target SMILES. The tool `apply_template` will return a list of precursor SMILES strings (each list element corresponds to one possible combination of precursors).</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC C C1(OH)C(F)(F)F",
    "template_id": "1914384"
}</action_input>
